counterfactual_missing_items: No follicular plugging or hyperkeratosis is described
No direct immunofluorescence/lupus band test result is provided
No photosensitivity or preceding inflammatory episodes are reported
decisive_items: atrophic lesions on his face, symmetric and bilateral, located especially on the malar and preauricular areas
Orcein stain demonstrated reduction of elastic fibers in the dermis beneath the epidermal dell
response.rationale: R3 uniquely integrates the clinical distribution (symmetric malar/preauricular atrophic lesions) with the histopathologic triad of epidermal dell, superficial dermal lymphocytic infiltrate, and dermal fibrosis, plus reduced elastic fibers on orcein, consistent with atrophic discoid lupus. R5 captures only the elastic-fiber reduction and misses the lymphocytic infiltrate and clinical context; R2 would require granulomas, and R1/R4/R6 lack the specific histologic combination.

rejected.why: Lymphocytic infiltrate and fibrosis are nonspecific; no mucin deposition or follicular alopecia is described.
Sarcoidosis would require non-caseating granulomas; the lesions are atrophic and non-indurated, not typical sarcoid.
Clinical atrophy overlaps, but no follicular plugging or follicular-centered histology is present; DLE better explains the epidermal dell and fibrosis.
Atrophic lesions overlap, but the lymphocytic infiltrate and dermal fibrosis are not accounted for; elastic-fiber loss alone is insufficient.
